mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, shop_id, total_amount, remark, status, pay_status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{payStatus})

mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, total_amount AS totalAmount, remark, status, pay_status AS payStatus, pay_time AS payTime, finish_time AS finishTime, cancel_time AS cancelTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId}
